14: - **Systemd Sandboxing Directives:**
15:   - `NoNewPrivileges=true`: Prevents execution of SUID binaries from gaining new privileges.
16:   - `ProtectSystem=strict`: Mounts entire filesystem hierarchy read-only except explicitly allowed paths.
17:   - `ProtectHome=true`: Makes `/home`, `/root`, and `/run/user` inaccessible and empty.
18:   - `PrivateTmp=true`: Allocates isolated `/tmp` and `/var/tmp` namespaces.
19:   - `ProtectKernelTunables=true`: Mounts `/proc/sys`, `/sys`, etc. read-only.
20:   - `ProtectControlGroups=true`: Mounts `/sys/fs/cgroup` read-only.
21:   - `ReadWritePaths=/opt/shajare1_bot`: Limits write scope exclusively to the bot application directory (needed for SQLite DB, logs, and temp exports).
